stage: U0/U1/U2 training-before upper bound and fairness
authorization: user explicit U0/U1/U2 protocol and start approval; supersedes earlier no scene optimization scope

statistics.PSNR: poolfloat64SSE/(3validpixels), then -10log10; independently per scene/focus, each aperture also reported
statistics.patch_pool: whole unmasked fixed64px grid weighted by regional pixel support
statistics.RGB: standard displayRGBfloat[0,1];raw linearEXR retained;3D integrates true linearRGB
statistics.full_image: all pixels including sky and peeled-reference residuals

band.definition: 3x3 relative inverse-depth jump, union of max-local-CoC1.5x footprints; exclusively target current visible depth
band.primary_evaluation: band excluding previously flagged peeled-reference residual pixels;band itself is never GT-filtered
band.report: independent disocclusionGT recall/precision/FP/FN, unknownGT support and CoC distribution; no tuning toGT recall

quality.direction: PSNRgain>0 AND LPIPSchange<-3noise;absLPIPSchange<=3noise is tie,not direction improvement or significant deterioration
quality.guardrails: per-focus pooled full-image and in-focus PSNR versusO3 each drop<=0.2dB; individual cases also reported

noise.source: L1 preregistered band-weighted independent Cycles pairs at frames1/30;maximum corresponding lens pair used forframe60

LPIPS_full_image_tie.rule: absolute difference <=3 times maximum independent-pair whole-image patch LPIPS at same lens and formal B2 SPP, frames1/30; frame60 uses maximum; existing B2 noise record only

U0.representation: actual Blender pinhole light field, no Gaussian appearance approximation
U0.integration: unclipped scene-linear mean, then existing displayRGB clipping for metrics
U0.noise_check: pilot independent seed; noise compared with existing formal B2 independent noise; if too high use2048 for all evaluation subviews at that lens before full rendering
U0.geometry_check: same normalized pixel rays and focal plane; compare Blender projection matrix with exported OpenCV K/E; max projected testpoint difference0.05px; inspect same-subcamera Blender and GT GS overlay
reported: all region PSNR and fixed patch LPIPS
differences versus O3 and unoptimized L2
fixed64 integration error and GT noise
U0.numeric_pass_fail: report only, as requested; no invented retrospective numerical threshold; interpret residuals against O3/L2 and noise

U1.visible: same observed-sky V-G initialization as correctedL2
U1.hidden: fixed O6-GT-rec; source parents restricted by current-visible-depth method band; no scoring masks in training
U1.training_pattern: independent randomized disk, seed2026111101; evaluation fixed64 positions excluded
U1.loss: 0.8 L1 +0.2(1-SSIM), full unmasked training images in standard displayRGB; no DOF supervision; no LPIPS loss
U1.optimization_budget: up to8000 steps/frame; all5 attribute types optimized; no densification; heldout every500; training-only final checkpoint, heldout never selects checkpoint
U1.small_position_bound: per Gaussian world displacement norm <=min(0.02m,0.01*initial axial depth); observed sky same relative bound
U1.overfit_stop: after1000 steps, training-view PSNR exceeds heldout by>3dB for3 consecutive monitors; nonfinite loss or persistent training loss failure also stops and reports
U1.formal_method_value: same inherited L2 quality+secondary+>=5/6 significant directions+full/focus >=-0.2dB versus O3; mechanism versus its same-optimized-visible no-hidden control also reported
U1.worth_training: at least onefocus passes formal_method_value AND pooled full-image PSNR gain overO3>=0.5dB AND full-image LPIPS not worse beyond3noise

U2.inference: one joint13-input-frame inference, no target DOF or GT geometry input
U2.alignment: one Umeyama Sim3 fitted to13 GT and predicted camera centers; rigid orientation consistency reported; same one global scale for every depth; no per-frame or per-region correction

variants.E2: same scaled DA3 depths +Sim3-aligned DA3 poses

methods: ours observed-skyVG + sameL3 retrieval + predicted-depth band + input-onlyLaMa fill
U2.GT_geometry_ours_reference: existing corrected L3, not U1 optimized Oracle; same input RGB and retrieval rule
U2.GT_allowed: single global coordinate alignment and evaluator only; no GT hidden geometry/labels/masks in prediction
U2.degradation: Delta_ours=ours(E)-ours(GT geometry);Delta_O3=O3(E)-O3(GT depth); report in GT-defined band/recoverable/full
U2.formal_pass: at least onefocus pooled band Delta_ours-Delta_O3>=0.3dB AND>=5/6 case PSNR degradation advantages>0 AND same full/focus direct-comparison O3(E) guardrails>=-0.2dB; LPIPS degradation and direct method comparison reported
U2.geometry_stop: joint inference nonfinite/fails, invalidSim3, or no stable depth bands with>=1000 pixels; report before expanding scope

limits: one controlledmain scene,3 representativeframes,6 lensconditions per focus; correlated repeatedpixels are not independent scene samples
U1 is per-scene optimized proxy, not proof of attainable feedforward performance
O5/O6 are not perfect optical Oracles
U2 relative robustness is empirical evidence or counterevidence only within this scene
deadline: 2026-11-18 approximately; report incomplete items and causes rather than expand scope
